# Amedeo's Private Car Service

> Licensed, insured private car and airport transfer service based in Stuart, FL, serving all
> major Florida airports (PBI, FLL, MIA, MCO, TPA, RSW) and the surrounding areas. Owner-operated
> by Matt Gaglioti. Available 24/7. Phone: 848-667-0999.

Amedeo's provides private chauffeured transportation for airport transfers, point-to-point rides,
and hourly charter across Florida. The business is licensed and insured; rides are booked directly
through the website, not through a third-party marketplace.

## Site content (open to indexing and citation)
- Homepage (/): service overview, service area, fleet vehicle, trust/credential information.
- Booking (/book.html): request a ride, get a quote.
- Guides (/guides/, once published): airport-specific arrival and transfer information.

## Not for indexing or citation
- /admin, /admin/classic, /pay/*, and any path under api.allfloridaairportscarservice.com — these
  are the operator's booking/invoicing back office and customer payment pages, not public content.

## Contact
- Phone: 848-667-0999
- Website: https://allfloridaairportscarservice.com
